{{Quote|Absolutely pathetic! My grandmother can throw better than that!|Teebo, while playing drop-the-sack|<ref name="tcott" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] was the '''grandmother''' of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], who lived in [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="tcott" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{EwoksDate|the mention of [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo's]] [[Parent/Legends|grandmother]]|[[The Cries of the Trees]]}}</ref> while playing a game of [[drop-the-sack]], where his Ewok friends tried to drop a sack on his head, Teebo was unimpressed with their throwing abilities, jokingly comparing them to that of his grandmother.<ref name="tcott" />

==Behind the scenes==
Teebo's grandmother was mentioned in "[[The Cries of the Trees]],"<ref name="tcott" /> the first episode of the [[Ewoks: Season One|first season]] of the animated series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']], which was written by [[Paul Dini]] and aired on [[September 7]], [[1985]].<ref name="Insider 27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
